item.title: Inaniwa Udon: Akita's Silky Handmade Noodles — Guide
item.description: Inaniwa udon, from Akita’s Yuzawa region, is one of Japan’s three great udon alongside Sanuki and Mizusawa — distinguished by its extraordinarily thin, silky-smooth strands made through a laborious multi-day hand-stretching process. Served cold in summer with dipping broth, or warm in a clear dashi, it is a study in refined simplicity. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Yuzawa (Inaniwa), Akita Hours Restaurant hours Admission ~¥900–1,500 a bowl Time needed About 45 min Best time Year-round; cold in summer What to Try Extraordinarily thin, silky-smooth udon strands.
